# reducto.ai

Reducto is a document-processing platform for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying, and editing documents such as PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and office files. It provides cloud and enterprise deployment options for AI and workflow teams processing documents at scale.

4 integrations · MCP · REST · CLI

Reducto exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at `https://platform.reducto.ai`, a hosted bearer-authenticated MCP server at `https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp`, a public docs MCP server at `https://docs.reducto.ai/mcp`, and a `reducto` CLI installed from PyPI.

Credentials

Reducto API keybearer[Get token ↗](https://studio.reducto.ai/)

Create an account in [Reducto Studio](https://studio.reducto.ai/). In the Studio sidebar, click **API Keys** and then **Create new API key**. Use the key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for HTTP calls, set `REDUCTO_API_KEY` for SDKs and agent tools, or let `reducto login` / `uvx mcp-server-reducto --login` acquire it for local developer tooling.

Reducto CLI login sessionoauth2`$ reducto login`

Acquired by the CLI — running `reducto login` opens the auth flow and stores the credential.
